rich_narrative.summary: Sachse Muslim Society is a religious and educational organization founded in 2014 that provides community services and Quranic education programs in Sachse, Texas, and surrounding areas <cite id="3">according to FY2024 filings</cite>. While the organization maintains <cite id="2">zakat-eligible status</cite> and raised <cite id="3">$3,647,357 in total revenue in FY2024</cite>, severe financial efficiency limitations present substantial barriers for donors. In FY2024 filings, the organization reported a <cite id="1">program expense ratio of 13.6%</cite> (with a score-adjusted ratio of 14%), leaving the vast majority of expenditure spent outside direct program activities. This figure falls drastically short of the <cite id="1">75% industry standard benchmark</cite> and the <cite id="1">89.2% peer median</cite> for humanitarian and community organizations. Additionally, the charity holds an excessive accumulation of unallocated capital, holding <cite id="1">63.0 months of operating reserves in working capital</cite> rather than deploying funds into direct service delivery. On public ratings, it holds <cite id="1">an overall score of 61.0/100 from Charity Navigator</cite>.
